lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for home new_flow changes, as only 1 test has been conducted so far despite winning.
Evidence is still thin for finish new_screen, sign_in hint, and choose_path copy changes, as each has only 1 test showing no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too high, overestimating gains in 3 out of 4 tests.

candidates.title: Postpone sign-in after pet adoption
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to after adoption certificate screen so users personalize their pet before creating or logging into an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in step drops 27.1% of users early before attachment, and 8 support emails noted account sign-in reset pet data.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption preserves all required steps and is explicitly allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strongest evidence with 8 support mails and 27.1% early dropoff.

candidates.title: Carousel redesign for pet selection
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a full visual carousel featuring rich card previews of pre-made pets.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and long decision time (median 89s, mean 1017s).

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Browse and pick a ready-to-play pet to join you on your desktop right away.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pet selection screen into a visual carousel preserves its primary job without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Targeting 39.1% dropoff step, but evidence relies primarily on funnel data.

candidates.title: Desktop control tutorial screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated interactive guide screen before finishing onboarding that demonstrates desktop controls and tray icon access.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to pets, and finish step drops 35.2%.

new_desktop_guide.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Pet
new_desktop_guide.body: Use the system tray icon to hide, feed, or talk to your pet anytime while working.

guard.reason: Adding a new tutorial screen inside onboarding is allowed under rule 4 and preserves all required steps.

candidates.score_note: High dropoff step with 3 support tickets, but previous new_screen test showed only +0.9%.

candidates.title: Animated desktop setup progress flow
candidates.change: Rebuild the waiting screen to display step-by-step progress bars and estimated remaining time while pet assets load.
candidates.why: Waiting/home screen takes a long time (mean 2336s) and 3 support emails reported desktop pet loading issues.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Pet Workspace
waiting.body: We are setting up your pet's desktop rendering and animations. This will only take a moment.

guard.reason: Adding visual progress and actual wait time indicators to the waiting screen preserves its function and complies with rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high drop time (2336s) and 3 emails; previous new_flow test won +4.8%.

candidates.title: Account pet recovery copy clarification
candidates.change: Update sign-in screen header and body to explicitly explain that signing in preserves existing pets and cloud saves.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress
sign_in.body: Use your registered account email to keep your pet settings and cloud sync active.
sign_in.hint: Make sure to sign in with the email used when creating your pet.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.body' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Photo formatting guidance hint
candidates.change: Add explicit photo quality instructions on the photo upload screen regarding lighting and file formats.
candidates.why: 3 support complaints noted custom pet generation failing or looking distorted.

upload_photos.hint: Use bright, front-facing photos in PNG or JPG format for accurate custom pet creation.

guard.reason: Adding photo guidance hints on the upload screen is a valid onboarding enhancement.

candidates.score_note: Cheap config hint addressing 3 complaints about custom pet upload distortion.

candidates.title: Split path selection layout
candidates.change: Change path selection to a side-by-side split layout clearly distinguishing instant pre-made pets from custom pets.
candidates.why: choose_path mean time is high (514s), indicating user confusion between paths.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Onboarding Experience
choose_path.body: Adopt a ready-made companion instantly or create your own custom pet from photos.

guard.reason: Split layout for path selection clearly offers both adopting pre-made pets and creating custom pets, maintaining screen job.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 514s mean time on choose_path through split visual layout.

candidates.title: Spotlight introduction layout
candidates.change: Change home_intro layout to spotlight focus emphasizing desktop pet activation.
candidates.why: Finish step dropoff is 35.2% and post-onboarding confusion remains high.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click finish to launch your companion onto your screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro layout stays inside onboarding bounds and preserves screen function.

candidates.score_note: Aims to fix 35.2% finish step dropoff with spotlight focus.

candidates.title: Photo processing visual indicator
candidates.change: Display status text and progress bar during photo upload verification.
candidates.why: Adoption mean time is 1017s and users experience custom pet generation errors.

guard.reason: Adding visual photo verification indicators to photo upload is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Tackles 1017s mean wait time during custom pet generation in adoption step.

candidates.title: Clear intro expectation copy
candidates.change: Update story screen intro copy to set quick setup expectations for new desktop pet owners.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 19.2%, needing better motivation right at the start.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets
story.body: In less than two minutes, bring a personal virtual companion directly to your computer screen.

guard.reason: Updating intro copy on the story screen introduces the pet concept without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Easy copy change but previous choose_path copy test yielded -0.2% relative lift.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen, layout), sign_in (hint, reorder), and choose_path (copy, layout) changes, as each kind of change has only 1 test so far.
home new_flow changes have 2 tests agreeing on positive noise-corrected gains (+4.6% and +1.2%); since one test won, this kind of change can be helpful.
No clear effect was seen for most changes tested so far (7 out of 8 tests).
Predictions were generally too high, overestimating impact in almost all tests.
